title: 15 青山书院16 怎么可以不行
content_zh:
名动广南府数月的紫轩阁花魁乘青鸟而去，与之同行的乃是写下《如梦令》的才子沈念。
据说当晚在紫轩阁有幸见证此佳作诞生的读书人都看到了五十年都未曾出现的才气。
且《如梦令》是以一种未曾见过的奇特字体书写，那晚之后，许多读书人纷纷模仿，据说这字体也是这位沈公子所创。
只是二人所往何处，所谓何事是无人知晓，也不知道以后是否还能见到二人的身影。
广南府城郊。
青山书院。
距离见过沈念已经隔了两日，或许他已经化险为夷了吧。
杨可岚那日回来便碰到大师兄顾白里。
看到对方关切的眼神，突然自己像做了错事一般，得知自己是去见了沈念，大师兄没有表现出明显的不悦，只是深深叹了一口气。
而这一声叹气却是让自己心乱如麻。
她不知何时起，开始在意师兄对自己的好，也开始十分介意在师兄面前提到沈念。
也许自己早就对师兄动心了。
他腹有诗气，胸怀天下，他是难得一见的俊杰。
他温柔如玉，心细如发，他是懂自己喜怒哀乐的知己。
而在两人之间，沈念便是那个必须解决的阻碍。
她杨岢岚是没法在有婚约的情况下，接受另一个人的爱，哪怕是自己的师兄。
早修结束，周围的师兄弟说说笑笑起身，而杨可岚依旧沉浸在自己的小世界中。
“可岚师姐，可岚师姐。”
面对师弟周怀意的叫喊，杨岢岚过了几拍才反应过来。
“怎么了，周师弟！”

“你看我这新学的字体如何？”
杨可岚凝神望去，只见通篇书法都是一种颇有风格的字体，锐利，蓬勃，甚至有些高雅......
“当真别具一格，这是哪位书法大家的新字体？“
另外一位书院学子抢话道：”周师弟，你这‘瘦金体’临摹的已经颇有味道了。“
“瘦金体？”
杨可岚也来了兴趣，作为读书人，有格调的字体谁人不喜？
周怀意笑道：“师姐是女子，自然不知道前两日紫轩阁发生的大事，咱广南府出了一位年轻的才俊，不过与我们一般年纪，但这字体便是他所创！”
一般年纪，开创新的字体？
杨岢岚道：“山外还比一山高，没想到广南府还有此等才俊。”
“还不止呢！”
另外的书院学子补充道：“他那首大茶围的佳作《如梦令》，可了不得，据说竟然生出了才气。”
此话一出，在场的书院弟子纷纷聚拢过来，这可确实是件了不得的事情。
诗词一道，引起天地共鸣方可生出才气，可天地的口味何其刁钻，凡品岂会入眼。
杨岢岚急忙问道：“可否诵来一听？”
“是啊，是啊，快快诵来。”
content_en:
The oiran of Zixuan Pavilion, who had been famous in Guangnan Prefecture for several months, left on a blue bird, and accompanying him was the talented scholar Shen Nian who wrote "Ru Meng Ling".
It is said that the scholars who were lucky enough to witness the birth of this masterpiece in Zixuan Pavilion that night saw a talent that had not appeared in fifty years.
Moreover, "Ru Meng Ling" was written in a strange font that had never been seen before. After that night, many scholars imitated it. It is said that this font was also created by Mr. Shen.
It's just that no one knows where the two of them are going or what they are doing, and no one knows if they will be seen again in the future.
The suburbs of Guangnan Prefecture.
Qingshan Academy.
It had been two days since I met Shen Nian, maybe he had saved the day.
When Yang Kelan came back that day, he met his elder brother Gu Baili.
Seeing the other party's concerned eyes, he suddenly felt as if he had done something wrong. When he learned that he had gone to see Shen Nian, the senior brother did not show any obvious displeasure, but just sighed deeply.
But this sigh made me feel confused.
She didn't know when she started to care about her senior brother's kindness to her, and she also started to mind mentioning Shen Nian in front of her senior brother.
Maybe I have been attracted to my senior brother for a long time.
He has a poetic spirit and a world-wide mind. He is a rare hero.
He is as gentle as jade and as considerate as hair. He is a confidant who understands his own joys, sorrows and joys.
Between the two of them, Shen Nian is the obstacle that must be resolved.
She, Yang Kelan, could not accept the love of another person, even her senior brother, when she was engaged.
After morning practice, the fellow disciples around him stood up chatting and laughing, but Yang Kelan was still immersed in his own little world.
"Senior Sister Kelan, Senior Sister Kelan."
Facing the shouts of his junior brother Zhou Huaiyi, it took Yang Kelan a few beats to react.
"What's wrong, Junior Brother Zhou!"
"What do you think of my new handwriting?"
Yang Kelan looked at it intently and saw that the entire calligraphy was a rather stylized font, sharp, vigorous, and even somewhat elegant...
"It's really unique. Which calligrapher's new font is this?"
Another academy student jumped in and said, "Junior Brother Zhou, your copy of the 'Skinny Gold Body' is already quite tasteful."
"Skinny gold body?"
Yang Kelan also became interested. As a scholar, who doesn't like stylish fonts?
Zhou Huaiyi smiled and said: "Senior sister is a woman, so naturally she doesn't know about the major events that happened in Zixuan Pavilion two days ago. We have a young talent from Guangnan Mansion, but he is about the same age as us, but this font was created by him!"
Ordinary age, creating a new font?
Yang Kelan said: "The mountains outside are higher than the other mountains. I didn't expect that there are such talents in Guangnan Mansion."
"That's not all!"
Another academy student added: "His masterpiece "Ru Meng Ling" written by Da Chawei is amazing. It is said that he actually developed a talent."
As soon as these words came out, the academy disciples present gathered around one after another. This was indeed an extraordinary thing.
Poetry can produce talent only when it resonates with heaven and earth, but the tastes of heaven and earth are so tricky that ordinary products will not be pleasing to the eye.
Yang Kelan asked hurriedly: "Can you recite it?"
"Yes, yes, recite it quickly."
